text:
Hi there! Thanks for reaching out, and I'm sorry to hear you're thinking about leaving us! 🌱

Great question about your Plant Club subscription. Here's what happens:

**When you delete your account:**
- Your account deletion takes up to **30 days** to process
- **Your Plant Club subscription will be automatically cancelled** as part of that process
- You can manage this yourself from "Account" > "Subscriptions" if you'd like to cancel Plant Club before deleting your account

**A couple of things to know:**
- If a Plant Club box has already been billed for the month (charged on the 25th of the previous month), it will still ship even if you've requested deletion—we can't stop a box that's already paid and in the queue
- Once your account is deleted, you won't be able to access your Plant Club or any other account features

**If you want to keep getting plants but just need a break**, you could also **pause your Plant Club for up to 3 months** instead of deleting your account entirely. That might be worth considering!

Is there anything I can help with, or would you like any more information about the process? I'm here if you have questions! 😊
